::: {#exm-collatz}
#### A proposition whose truth value nobody knows

Start with a positive integer $n$.
If $n$ is even, replace it with $n / 2$;
if $n$ is odd, replace it with $3n + 1$.
Repeat.
Starting from $n = 6$ gives
$6, 3, 10, 5, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1$.

The *Collatz conjecture* [@wikipedia_collatz_conjecture]
is the sentence
"starting from any positive integer, the process reaches 1 after finitely many steps".
It is a proposition,
because it is either true or false,
but nobody has yet proved which.
A proposition needs a definite truth value, not a known one.

:::
